held.title: The build may not emit the `.mjs`/`.d.mts` files that package.json exports.
held.body: `cache-api/package.json` exports `./dist/index.mjs`, `./dist/file-system.mjs` and the types `./dist/index.d.mts`. This config does not set `fixedExtension: true`, which `playwright-intent/tsdown.config.ts` does set. With `"type": "module"` and a tsdown version where `fixedExtension` defaults to false, the output is `index.js` and `index.d.ts`. The published package would then fail to resolve. The e2e harness and tsconfig map to `src`, so the tests would not catch this. Set `fixedExtension: true`, or check what the build actually emits.

held.title: A write change with no source deletes the stored step.
held.body: `applyChanges` treats every change that is not a write with a source as a delete. If a `RunChange` of kind `write` reaches `deliver` without `source`, the step is removed from `main.zip` and every branch has to regenerate it. `RunChange.source` is optional, and I could not check that every write record carries one. Only delete on `kind === "delete"`, and skip or throw on a write that has no source.
